description: Dear Friends and Neighbors, DHEC just announced 163 new cases of COVID-19 and 5 additional deaths. This brings the total number of people confirmed to have COVID-19 in South Carolina to 8,816 and those who have died to 385. Richland County, specifically zip codes 29223 and 29229 continue to have some of the highest positive cases in the state.
